about: Answer sheet for audience_reader: a founder's words -> the facts that define their room. Written by hand. `facts` and `provinces` are what a careful person would pick from audience_reader.OPTIONS; `unmatched` names each thing that must come back as 'can't match' (matched by its first word). Score with scripts/check_audience_cases.py; tests/test_audience_reader.py guards the keyword-only score. Cases marked held_out were written after the keywords were tuned and were not tuned against: their score is the honest one. Cases marked needs_reader use wordings the keyword list does not know; they are scored only with the typed reader on (FUB_TYPED_AUDIENCE=1).

cases.text: The out-of-pocket healthcare segment in South Africa consists of an estimated 10 to 16 million people who fall into what economists call the "missing middle". These individuals live predominantly in urban provinces, earn between R7 500 and R30 000 per month, and are often younger workers or informal entrepreneurs who actively rely on pay-as-you-go healthcare products instead of traditional monthly premiums.
